title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for R must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Length Equations
description: Important Criteria: The equations for the lengths l1 and l2 after heating must be correctly stated.

title: Curvature Relation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between the lengths and the radius of curvature must be correctly established.

title: Substitutions
description: Important Criteria: Correct substitutions from the length equations into the curvature relation must be shown.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in the equations for l1 and l2.
